topPRs.title: release: promote develop → production (money-integrity wave, monetization rails, auth overhaul, live rate limiting)
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## Production promote: develop → main (444 commits)

Prod has been running a **manually-promoted develop frontend** (`d2b8782`, via local `wrangler pages deploy`) against a **day-old Worker and schema** since ~00:00Z — any main push regresses the frontend; the skew only grows. This PR makes prod durable and lockstep: merging triggers `cloud-deploy-backend` (migrate-db) **and** `cloud-cf-deploy` (Worker `--env production`, both Pages `--branch=main`) from the same main push.

Full runbook: `PROD_PROMOTE_RUNBOOK.md` in the deploy-lane worktree + condensed in elizaOS/eliza#10561 (comment 4862165568). Analysis: 4-agent delta/hazard/mechanics/validation pass over `main..develop`.

### Pre-merge checklist (why this is DRAFT)
- [x] **REDIS_URL present in prod Worker env** — verified 2026-07-02 ~05:50Z via `wrangler secret list --env production` (223 secrets; REDIS_URL + MCP cache Redis present). The #10620 fail-closed rate-limit guard will pass. (Presence-verified; a dead URL degrades to fail-open limiting, not an outage.)
- [x] develop merges into main clean (`git merge-tree --write-tree`: no conflicts; the 2 main-only CodeQL commits reconcile with their develop-parity equivalents)
- [x] Staging validated on this code lineage (sign-in renders, onboarding renders, 0 CORS, API health ok — #10561 00:55Z + 01:55Z evidence)
- [ ] **Deploy window**: robots take ONE deploy at a time (#11108). At merge time, hold develop deploy runs until the main run completes (the cloud/laptop agent session runs the escort and will cover this — ping in #10561).
- [ ] **Watch `migrate-db` go green** on the main push (cloud-deploy-backend). If it fails, the Worker still ships → roll the Worker back (re-dispatch env=production from `23f33ccc`) or hotfix the DB before traffic notices.
- [ ] Post-deploy validation: automated harness (bundle-hash flip, 5 sign-in options render, 0 CORS, `api/health` ok) + the 2-minute real sign-in → message → credits-deduct manual pass. Abort/rollback signals in the runbook (Pages = CF dashboard rollback, proven 06-25).

### What ships (headlines)
- **Money-integrity wave**: creator-earnings idempotency across all money routes; 3 payout double-pay windows closed; Stripe refund/chargeback clawbacks (non-negative); atomic crypto top-up; upfront credit reservation vs `max_tokens`; org-credit gates on agent resume; per-app API key scoping; per-org agent/container caps. Zero-balance orgs start getting **correct rejections** — visible behavior change.
- **Monetization rails**: miniapp Stripe/OxaPay credit rails + compliance-review gate + admin-approved USDC payouts; ad SSP; influencer marketplace w/ escrow; managed frontend hosting; agent-driven custom domains.
- **Auth/onboarding overhaul**: apex lands authed users on the console (#11031, already hand-promoted); same-origin API proxy; OAuth redirect + Suspense crash + session-loop fixes; apex-401 root fix (#11004); reworked first-run onboarding; pre-auth polling gated (#11084).
- **Rate limiting goes live** in prod (#10620) — pre-check above clears the fail-closed guard.
- Optional secrets degrade gracefully if unset: `OXAPAY_MERCHANT_API_KEY`, `ELIZA_AD_TAG_SECRET`, `ELIZA_FRONTEND_HOST_SUFFIX`, `APP_REVIEW_MODEL`. `FAL_KEY` is present-but-invalid (#11005) — independent ops fix, not gated on this PR.

### Migrations
9 additive migrations (0155–0163: withdrawal idempotency, frontend hosting, compliance gate w/ backfill, influencer + ad tables, domains anti-squat unique swap). Auto-applied by migrate-db on the main push; old code ignores the new tables, so a code rollback needs no schema rollback.

**Draft until @NubsCarson + @lalalune call it.** Merging this = production deploy.

topPRs.title: test(ui,app,agent): onboarding/voice/background/interaction QA follow-ups + de-larp (#11083 follow-up)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Follow-up hardening for the onboarding/chat/voice/gesture/background epic
(**PR #11083, merged** as `a9be4f48c70a`). A 6-agent audit of that epic surfaced
a set of residual gaps + test-honesty issues; this PR closes the
locally-achievable, verifiable ones. Branched fresh off `develop` (9 commits, 0
behind), so it layers cleanly on top of the merged epic **and** develop's
subsequent shader refinement (#11088/#11102).

## What's in it

**Voice / #10700 — converse-mode fuzz dimension.** The shell send/voice/new-chat
fuzz declared converse (VAD/semantic end-of-turn commit→send) a *deferred*
dimension. Added it: the fuzz now drives converse capture through the **real**
`TurnAggregator` (a complete final commits synchronously → VOICE_DM send) and
asserts `lastTurnVoice` clears on every new-chat; a dedicated test proves a
complete converse final sends a VOICE_DM (not a plain DM) + a negative (pure
disfluency commits but the respond-gate drops it). Also corrected the header's
mock disclosure (sendChatText is the separately-pinned send-queue leaf).

**Background / #10694 residuals.**
- **Redo now persists across reload** (deliverable was "undo + redo, bounded,
  persisted" — redo was in-memory only).
- **Killed the e2e store-mirror larp:** extracted one pure, browser-safe reducer
  (`state/background-history.ts`, `applyBackgroundSet/Undo/Redo`) used by BOTH
  `useDisplayPreferences` and the e2e fixture — the fixture no longer hand-mirrors
  the history semantics, so drift is impossible. Added a direct reducer unit test.

**Voice-test honesty / #10726.** Retired the tautological WER assertion in the
Chromium voice lanes (the mock ASR echoes the expected phrase → WER structurally
0, can never regress). The load-bearing "a real WAV reached ASR" assert stays;
WER accuracy is scored only in the real-recognizer tiers.

**Chat UI regression gates.**
- **#10698:** computed-style gate that message bubbles have **no** per-message
  fill (the backdrop-blur gate bans blur, not a fill) — 12 bubbles asserted
  transparent.
- **#10706:** real CDP-touch **pull-down** opens the NotificationCenter sheet
  (was jsdom-synthetic only). Also fixed a real bug: `run-home-screen-e2e` called
  an orphaned `swipeRight()` helper (only `swipeLeft` survived a develop rebase),
  crashing the whole home CI lane with a ReferenceError.
- **#10713:** the per-message COPY test now reads `navigator.clipboard.readText()`
  back and asserts the bytes, not just the "Copied" label.

**Interaction de-larp / #10722.**
- **Real drag-to-reorder launcher e2e:** a genuine Framer `Reorder.Item` pointer
  drag that fires reorder telemetry, changes the tile order, persists to
  `LAUNCHER_STORAGE_KEY`, and drops/duplicates no ids (verified live: 0→23
  reorder events, 25 unique ids). The mock-based `Launcher.gestures.test` and
  `use-pull-gesture.test` are relabelled as explicitly **logic-only** (they no
  longer overstate gesture-pipeline coverage).
- **View-capability gate de-larped:** it was vacuously true (passed on any
  `VIEW_ACTION_MAP` entry — every view has one) and blind to the 8 spatial views
  (which instrument via `agent=` → `data-agent-id`, not `useAgentElement`, so they
  passed as 0-control for free — `documents` actually has 8 registrations counted
  as 0). Replaced with a proportional **density** gate over both DOM + spatial
  dialects (`>= ceil(controls / 4)` registrations), calibrated with headroom over
  the densest real view, plus a teeth/positive-control test that FAILS an
  8-control/1-registration source. Render-based coverage stays with the running-
  shell crawler (`@elizaos/agent` must not import 14 leaf view packages).
- **WebKit lane:** opt-in (`PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1`) Safari-engine project in the
  ui-smoke config, scoped to the permission-free pointer/focus/text-input specs.

**CI.** `app-real-e2e.yml` now exports `ELIZA_CHROME_PATH` (resolved from the
chromium it already installs) so the nightly live-streaming lane stops
self-skipping forever.

## Evidence (verified against this develop base)

- **Unit:** `packages/ui` touched suites **38/38** (background-history reducer,
  redo-persist round-trip, converse fuzz) + `packages/agent` view-capability
  **20/20**. ui + app typecheck clean (one pre-existing develop-wide
  `plugin-local-inference` dist-staleness error, untouched here).
- **E2E (real browser, green on this base):** launcher drag-reorder
  (`run-launcher-e2e` — real Framer drag → telemetry + persistence + no dup ids),
  home-screen pull-down (`run-home-screen-e2e`), chat-sheet no-fill
  (`run-chat-sheet-e2e`). Committed screenshots + walkthrough webms.

### Honest deferrals (N/A with reason — not larped)
- **#10710** full minimal-redesign + `ELIZA_AUDIT_APP_STRICT` flip — a separate
  redesign epic needing the `audit:app` 5-loop on a fully-built app. The "card
  chrome" in AutomationsFeed/CameraPageView/Launcher is **functional component
  shape** (launcher tiles, camera shutter, badges), not gratuitous card wrappers,
  so a blind strip would regress the design.
- **#10706 desktop-native tray notification** — a separate electrobun feature.
- **#9525 android-device-e2e dispatch** + audit-strict debt-seed — operator/CI
  actions (need a completed device run / a clean full-audit run to seed).
- **Live-Cerebras BACKGROUND scenario** — the scenario-runner harness can't boot
  locally (pre-existing `@elizaos/plugin-discord/user-account-scraper` +
  `plugin-local-inference` dist staleness; CI builds first). The BACKGROUND NL→
  plan→payload path is covered by deterministic tests over the **real**
  `inferBackgroundPlan`.

topPRs.title: refactor(ui,app): strip default-visible views to the minimal eliza aesthetic — flat surfaces, borderless controls, strict audit gate ON (#10710)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #10710.

## What this does

The full audit-and-strip pass over every default-visible view (system/release ViewKind), plus the gate work the issue's acceptance criteria require. Six parallel strip passes (character, documents, automations, apps/shell, settings/misc, training) + shared-primitive de-chroming + a polish round driven by three audit loops.

**Stripped:** structural borders, wrapper background fills, divider lines, card radii, decorative chips/count badges, and helper-text slop across: launcher/apps grid (dock solid-dark card → translucent wash; borderless tiles), automations (stat cards → plain figures; filter pills → borderless text tabs), documents (chips → middot text; borderless scope tabs; fixed illegible accent-fg label), character (editor panels/experience workspace/hub/roster/timeline), training/fine-tuning, secrets/config/settings residuals, stream, media gallery, wallet, pairing/startup-failure/bug-report shells, memories, chat overlay container chrome (HeaderButton → borderless icon-only; composer divider removed). Shared primitives: SegmentedControl outer box, PagePanelFeatureEmpty medallion border, sidebar toggle border + right-edge hairline.

**Kept (semantic):** warn/error/destructive boxes, focus rings, active-selection states, drag/drop zones, progress bars, modal/glass scrims (self-contained contrast over wallpaper), bottom-line input affordances, functional browser toolbars, graph-meaning node outlines.

**Fixed while in here:**
- Triple "Fine-Tuning" launcher tile (TAB_PATHS `fine-tuning` + `advanced` + the plugin-training `training` view id) — deduped via CANONICAL_ID; verified in pixels (one tile).
- Stream "Go Live" was a green CTA → accent (orange is the only accent; Stop stays danger).
- Native checkboxes/radios rendered UA blue → `:root { accent-color: var(--accent) }`.
- Radius gate: admits 3px (base.css collapses all --radius-* tokens to 3px) and 32px (the chat capsule's animated collapsed radius — it was flagging ALL 348 findings).
- CI strict flip (#10970 operator steps): `ELIZA_AUDIT_APP_STRICT=1` + `ELIZA_AUDIT_APP_STRICT_NEEDS_WORK=1` with empty debt.
- Minimalism ratchet refreshed: 41 entries (launcher family, documents, automations, fine-tuning, memories, stream all cleared from the debt record).
- Clicksafe probes for /apps, /views, /rolodex, /polymarket, /shopify — all five were failing on develop tip itself (verified on a clean develop worktree); re-anchored on real testids/toolbars + fixed the smokePolymarketStatus fixture missing its required `account` block.

## Numbers (audit: 349-test matrix, 5 viewports, rest+hover)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| verdicts | 136 good / 212 needs-eyeball | **307 good / 41 needs-eyeball** (0 needs-work, 0 broken) |
| radius violations | 348/348 findings | **0** |
| blue | 0 | 0 |
| launcher density (desktop/mobile, ceiling 45) | 89.5 / 303.8 | **6.2 / 24.3** |
| fine-tuning | 52.5 / 145.8 | 9.3 / 30.4 |
| automations | 37.0 / 145.8 | 6.2 / 24.3 |
| documents | 27.8 / 109.4 | 6.2 / 24.3 |

**Strict-gated run (both flags on, empty debt): 349/349 passed.** Remaining 41 needs-eyeball = baselined developer views + plugin app views (sibling scope) + 3 single-viewport builtin entries (browser/relationships mobile — functional toolbars / a form select on 390px).

## Evidence — `.github/issue-evidence/10710-strip-default-views/`

Before/after full-page screenshots (desktop+mobile, 18 views each), complete strict-run report.json + final-tree re-run, 100 filled manual-review verdicts (every default view `good`, eyeballed by hand), regenerated launcher walkthrough webm + per-step captures. Real-LLM trajectory: N/A — presentation/CSS + test-harness change, no model/action/prompt path. Backend logs: N/A — no server code path.

## Verification

- Full `packages/ui` suite: **5107 passed** (twice: post-strip, post-polish); post-develop-merge full-suite run hit a develop-side WidgetHost worker crash that reproduces on clean develop tip (bisect+fix in flight separately) — not from this branch.
- Per-group scoped runs during the strips: character 26, documents 2, automations 42, apps/shell 89, settings/misc 99, training 40 — all green; plugin-wallet-ui 39; launcher-curation 11.
- e2e: launcher e2e green (fresh walkthrough recorded); fixed clicksafe probes pass in ~1s each (were 3-minute timeouts, failing on develop too).
- typecheck (tsgo) + biome 2.5.1 clean on every touched file. Known pre-existing environmental red: packages/app strict typecheck fails on the plugin-local-inference dist gap (develop-wide, documented).

Known out-of-scope finding for the icon-artwork owner: several launcher icon assets contain blue pixels (invisible to the CSS audit).

topPRs.title: feat(ui): floating-chat onboarding lock + programmable GLSL shader background + interaction/QA de-larp (#9952, #10694, #10722, #10434)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Floating-chat onboarding + interaction/background QA epic. This branch makes the
in-chat first-run onboarding a true **modal lock**, ships the missing headline
feature of the app background (**arbitrary programmable GLSL shader**), removes
dead avatar plumbing, and de-larps several interaction/testing gaps surfaced by a
6-agent audit of the whole cluster (#9952, #10694, #10722, #10712, #9950, #10434,
plus the closed #10697/#10698/#10699/#10700/#10706/#10708/#10709/#10711/#10713/
#10715/#10717/#10720/#10322/#9525 which were verified real, not larp).

It is rebased clean onto `develop` (0 behind). Two of the pre-rebase commits
overlapped work that merged on develop in the meantime (#10694 undo/redo via
#10771/#10960; topic gestures via #10988) — those were reconciled: develop's
undo/redo kept, this branch's **superior** TopicGroup fix (`touch-pan-y` +
`suppressClickRef` — fixes a tap double-toggle develop's `touch-none` leaves
live) kept, the duplicate redo button dropped.

## What's in this PR

### Onboarding lock (#9952) — the user-flagged defect
develop still ships a **dismissable** onboarding chat with a **live composer**
during setup. This makes the floating chat a modal onboarding surface while
first-run is pending:
- opens pinned **FULL**; composer locked (textarea disabled → "Choose an option
  to continue"; attach/mic/PTT/send disabled; prefill/dictation/slash side-doors
  hard-guarded; the AppContext send backstop drops any non-`__first_run__:` value);
- **undismissable** — every collapse path (Escape, outside-tap, grabber
  pull-down/drag, header clear/launcher, conversation swipe, and — new here — the
  `TUTORIAL_CHAT_CONTROL_EVENT` rest/reset/prefill seam) is a no-op;
- **auto-collapses once** on the completion falling edge, revealing home.

Contract documented in `first-run/IN_CHAT_ONBOARDING_DESIGN.md`; covered by
`ContinuousChatOverlay.firstrun.test.tsx` (9 tests).

### Programmable GLSL shader background (#10694)
develop already had undo/redo; this adds the arbitrary programmable shader mode:
- `ProgrammableShaderBackground` renders a GLSL fragment via **raw three.js**
  (already a dep; no new deps) behind a full safety sandbox for untrusted GPU
  code: compile-validate before showing, clamped uniforms, frame-time watchdog,
  WebGL context-loss recovery, reduced-motion static frame, and a color-field
  fallback on any failure (a bad shader can never white-screen or hang the app);
- `BackgroundConfig` gains a `glsl` mode (source + presetId + typed/clamped
  uniforms); `normalizeBackgroundConfig` collapses a hostile/oversized/absent
  source to the color field on load;
- 5-preset GLSL library (aurora/lava/plasma/waves/nebula, bounded loops only);
- BACKGROUND action drives it from chat: named presets (+ synonyms), a generic
  "animated shader" → default, and relative tweaks (slower/brighter/bigger),
  with precedence so "red brighter" stays red and "molten" beats a bare color.

### Dead-route removal (#10434 follow-up)
#10434 removed the 3D companion but left the `/api/avatar/vrm` +
`/api/avatar/background` upload/serve routes, the dead client methods, and the
startup existence probes that only produced onboarding 404 noise. All removed;
live built-in avatar-index selection untouched.

### Interaction / testing de-larp
- **#10722 gestures** (already on branch, verified real): real CDP
  `Input.dispatchTouchEvent`, and the two production bugs it exposed
  (TopicGroup tap no-op, HomeScreen swallowing horizontal pans) fixed.
- **#10722 XR claim de-larped:** removed the WEBXR_PLATFORMS.md "validated
  end-to-end / read back two textured quads" overclaim (no test opens an
  immersive session or reads pixels; `enterImmersiveScene` has no caller) and
  added an explicit "NOT yet validated" section. (The sibling tui-pty "vacuous
  skip" finding was a **false negative** — the real-PTY suite IS wired into CI
  via test.yml's Real-PTY step and passes locally; left as-is.)
- **#9950 aesthetic gate** (already on branch): the density probe's
  catch-to-zero silently satisfied the minimalism budget/ratchet (a probe crash
  read as "perfectly minimal → pass"). Now recorded as a `densityProbeFailures`
  finding and the budget/ratchet skip a failed probe, so a crash can't
  manufacture a pass.
- **#10712 streaming** (already on branch): force-added the four gitignored
  live-run Cerebras logs the evidence README cites.

## Evidence

- **Tests, real + green (run in this worktree):**
  - `plugin-app-control` **1271/1271** (incl. the new BACKGROUND preset/tweak/
    precedence inference + emit tests).
  - `packages/ui` touched suites **339/339** — shader-schema (clamp/NaN/hostile/
    while-loop/hex), preset-library integrity, ProgrammableShaderBackground
    fallback + no-crash-on-garbage, persistence glsl round-trip + hostile-source
    collapse, AppBackground glsl render + fallback, a **400-step set/undo/redo
    storm fuzz** across shader/image/glsl, the onboarding firstrun lock (9), and
    the existing background/undo-redo suites.
  - `agent` real-PTY TUI smoke passes locally (`test:tui-pty`).
- **Real-LLM streaming trajectory (#10712):** committed SSE frame captures
  (`thinking→running_action→token×N`, monotonic lengths 47→85→133) +
  green/red live-run logs under `.github/issue-evidence/10712-live-streaming-thinking/`.
- **Screenshots / recordings:** the gesture, home-screen, background, and chat
  `__e2e__` output artifacts (png/webm) committed on-branch.
- **Typecheck/lint:** `packages/ui` + `plugins/plugin-app-control` typecheck +
  biome clean.

### N/A (with reasons — honest, not skipped)
- **Live Cerebras BACKGROUND-shader scenario:** `N/A here` — the scenario-runner
  harness can't boot in this local worktree (`@elizaos/plugin-discord/
  user-account-scraper` subpath unresolved from plugin-personal-assistant — a
  pre-existing develop-wide plugin dist-staleness issue; neither plugin touched
  here). The BACKGROUND shader NL→plan→payload→renderer path is covered by
  deterministic tests that exercise the **real** `inferBackgroundPlan` routing
  (not a mock); the live suite is the designated #10694 live-lane deliverable,
  runnable in CI where the workspace is built.
- **Isolated-browser shader e2e + `audit:app` 5-loop:** `N/A here` — need a full
  built app + headless-Chromium WebGL lane; tracked for the app visual-audit
  lane. Unit + component + story-gate + fuzz cover the shader in this PR.

## Known follow-ups (separate issues, out of this PR's coherent scope)
Surfaced by the audit, not blocking this bundle: #10710 (strip default views to
minimal + strict audit), the #10700 converse-mode voice fuzz dimension, the
#10699 real-browser transcribe-button click e2e, and the #10706 desktop-native
notification treatment.
